product_family: Cloud-based no-code database and workspace platform with AI-powered workflows, AI agents, and automations. Core product (Airtable Base/Workspace) with integrated AI features, automation engine, and extensible API.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Service Organization Controls audit (SOC 2 Type 2) completed. Airtable completes annual SOC 2 Type 2 audits.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information security management system certification. Airtable completes annual ISO 27001 audits.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701:2019
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 Privacy information management system framework certification. Airtable completes annual ISO 27701 audits.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: HIPAA compliance features are available for Enterprise Scale customers. Airtable has established HIPAA compliance requirements with Business Associate Agreement (BAA) support.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy and security have always been core to Airtable's approach. Airtable complies with Europe's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

certifications.name: TX-RAMP Level 2
certifications.proof_quote: TX-RAMP Level 2 certification for handling Texas state agency data. Ensures security program meets defined standards for state data.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR certification on Airtable's trust center or security pages.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 certification on Airtable's trust center or official security documentation.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: FedRAMP certification not mentioned on trust center. Community discussions indicate this certification has not been obtained.

certifications.name: PCI-DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI-DSS certification on Airtable's official security documentation.

privacy.ai_training_note: Airtable explicitly prohibits training AI models on customer data. Policy: 'Airtable will not use, or permit the Third-Party AI Providers or others to use, Input, Output, or any other Customer Data to train the generative artificial intelligence models used to provide Airtable AI.' Data retention: Enterprise Scale/Business plans retain no input/output; Free/Team/Pro/Plus plans may retain for up to 30 days for safety and compliance moderation.
privacy.data_region: Default: US (US-East-1 AWS). Optional: EU (Frankfurt with Dublin backups) for Enterprise Scale customers. Australian residency claimed on homepage but no confirmed Australian region offered.

security.name: Data Processing Addendum
security.value: Available with EU Standard Contractual Clauses (Module 2 and 3), UK SCCs, and Swiss data protection compliance

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: SSL/TLS encryption for data in transit

security.name: Enterprise Key Management (EKM)
security.value: Customer-owned encryption keys for data at rest (Enterprise Scale feature)

security.name: Access Controls
security.value: Role-based access control (RBAC), admin roles, fine-grained permissions, IDP-synced groups, programmatic provisioning/de-provisioning

security.name: Breach Notification
security.value: Commitment to notify customers of substantiated breaches within 72 hours

security.name: Vulnerability Management
security.value: Skilled security professionals specializing in Application Security and Infrastructure Security

products.name: Airtable Base/Workspace
products.data_scope: Customer data stored in Airtable bases; covered by all certifications
products.notes: Core no-code database product available on all plans (Free through Enterprise Scale)

products.name: Airtable AI
products.data_scope: Input/output to AI models; not used for training; retention varies by plan tier
products.notes: Integrates multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, AWS, IBM, Meta). Data not trained on. 30-day retention on lower plans, no retention on Enterprise/Business.

products.name: AI Agents
products.data_scope: AI agents orchestrate across customer data; same training and retention policies apply
products.notes: Enterprise feature for production-grade AI automation across workflows

products.name: Automations
products.data_scope: Automation logic and data flows; non-AI automation features

products.name: Airtable Portals
products.data_scope: Curated external access to Airtable data
products.notes: Allows customers to share read-only or collaborative views externally

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with tiered plans: Free, Team, Pro, Plus, Business, Enterprise Scale. HIPAA and advanced compliance features require Enterprise Scale.
compare.data_residency: US (default), EU (optional for Enterprise Scale), no Australian region despite homepage reference

flags: HIPAA is Enterprise Scale plan-specific feature, not a universal certification across all plans
Data Processing Addendum language modifications restricted to Enterprise accounts
AI data retention policy differs by plan tier: 30-day retention on Free/Team/Pro/Plus vs no retention on Enterprise/Business
Homepage claims Australian data residency support but no Australian AWS region confirmed in technical documentation
FedRAMP certification not obtained despite being standard for US government SaaS
ISO 42001 (AI governance certification) not obtained despite heavy AI feature emphasis
Third-party AI provider terms vary by provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, AWS, IBM, Meta) - customers inherit those terms
